text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا

words.root_display: no lexical root (annulment and emphasis particle)
words.gloss_range: emphatic opener whose predicate is delayed until the inner divine guarantee

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative pronoun governed by the opening emphasis
inner divine guarantee that supplies the delayed predicate

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens an emphatic frame but does not complete it at once. It governs {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhina}}) as the subject-position, then lets the believers be defined by faith and sound deeds before the predicate arrives as {{ar:إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ}} ({{tr:inna la nudiʿu}}). The result is not a flat description of believers but a double-emphasis structure in which divine speech completes the sentence as a guarantee. Across the boundary from 18:29, the emphatic divine voice that announced prepared punishment is answered by an emphatic preservation claim for reward.

topics.headline: double emphasis with delayed completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first emphasis stays open until divine speech supplies the sentence's real predicate.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the opening clause and identifies the later {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:inna}}) clause as the predicate-content of the first emphasis.

topics.headline: emphatic voice reverses the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the emphatic register crossing from 18:29 changes from punishment prepared for wrongdoers to reward preserved for those who act well.
topics.reason: The boundary claim is local because 18:29 and 18:30 both use emphatic divine assertion while reversing the outcome under discussion.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun defining a group by the following paired actions

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening emphatic particle governing the relative pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhina}}) names no tribe or static title. As the governed subject of the opening {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it holds the predicate open while its relative clause defines the group by two coordinated acts: they trusted and they worked restorative deeds. Its masculine plural form controls both following perfect verbs, so one referent carries both qualifications. After the wrongdoer-pronoun chain of 18:29, this word opens a fresh referent whose identity is action-shaped and then answered by the divine guarantee.

topics.headline: group identity built by the relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believers are introduced as a class formed by trust and restorative work, not as a pre-labeled social group.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhina}}) the governed relative pronoun whose clause contains both matching plural verbs.

topics.headline: fresh referent before the guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sentence first opens a new action-defined referent and only then lets divine speech complete the claim.
topics.reason: The first clause remains structurally incomplete until word 7, and the boundary row is consistent with the shift from 18:29's wrongdoer chain to this new relative referent.

words.gloss_range: completed plural trusting or believing, with no explicit object named in this ayah
words.root_gloss_range: belief, trust, security, and entrusted safety; local grammar selects the completed trust-position while leaving the object unstated

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prior faith-root form in 18:29 used for boundary comparison
relative pronoun supplying the plural subject

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:amanu}}) turns the choice opened in 18:29 into completed uptake: the prior {{ar:فَلْيُؤْمِن}} ({{tr:fal-yuʾmin}}) becomes a group who have actually trusted. The plural perfect ending points back to {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhina}}), while the absence of an explicit object keeps the state of trust itself prominent before the sentence names any reward. The root field of security and trust makes the later non-loss guarantee feel coherent: those who entered trust are answered by a promise that their recompense will not be abandoned. The word also begins the familiar belief-plus-righteous-deeds formula, which recurs later in the surah (18:107).

topics.headline: choice becomes completed trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:30 follows one branch of 18:29's choice by naming those who actually believed.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows compare the same faith root across 18:29 and 18:30, and QAC supports the perfect plural form here.

topics.headline: trust state before named object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb foregrounds entering trust or security before any explicit believed object is supplied.
topics.reason: The local verb instance has no explicit object, so the trust/security pressure survives, but it should not replace the ordinary belief reading.

topics.headline: belief joins work and reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this word starts a recurring faith-and-deeds formula that 18:30 turns into a preservation guarantee and 18:107 later unfolds as garden reward.
topics.reason: The formula rows are concrete and locally anchored in the immediate coordination with work and the later recurrence at 18:107.

topics.headline: human agency before divine guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah builds the human profile before shifting into first-person divine preservation.
topics.reason: Words 2-6 define the human side before word 7 introduces the divine first-person guarantee.

words.gloss_range: coordination joining the two perfect verbs inside the relative clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first coordinated perfect verb
second coordinated perfect verb

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is a simple coordinator, but that simplicity matters. It links {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:amanu}}) and {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilu}}) as twin perfect verbs under the same relative pronoun, without turning the second into a mere result clause. The ayah therefore moves from inward trust to outward work while keeping both as parallel qualifications of one group.

topics.headline: trust and work coordinated as twin criteria
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief and deed stand together as coordinated qualifications, not as a hierarchy where one grammatically absorbs the other.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies coordination between the two verbs inside the same relative clause.

topics.headline: hinge from trust into practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local movement from inward trust into observable work without a new clause or new actor.
topics.reason: The conjunction sits exactly between the two defining verbs and preserves the same subject.

words.gloss_range: completed plural working or doing, transitive here with the restorative things as direct object
words.root_gloss_range: intentional work, deed, practice, and productive action; local grammar narrows it to enacted restorative deeds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired faith verb sharing the subject
explicit restorative object of the work verb
final work-root noun that closes the ayah

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilu}}) shares its subject with {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:amanu}}) and matches it as a completed plural verb, so work belongs to the same action-defined group. It is transitive here: the worked object is {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣaliḥat}}), which makes the action enacted rather than merely possessed or admired. The root's pressure toward intentional, value-bearing production survives, while local grammar directs that production toward repair and soundness. This first work-root also opens an inclusio that closes with {{ar:عَمَلًا}} ({{tr:ʿamalan}}), moving from doing sound deeds to the measured excellence of deed.

topics.headline: work completes the paired human profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that work is not a new actor or loose add-on but the second completed verb in the believers' defining profile.
topics.reason: The verb shares the relative-pronoun subject and governs {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣaliḥat}}) as its explicit object.

topics.headline: intentional work narrowed by restorative object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah values deliberate productive action specifically as action directed toward soundness and repair.
topics.reason: The broad craft and intentional-action pressure is useful, but the local object narrows the work to {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣaliḥat}}), not every possible productive act.

topics.headline: work-root frames the ayah's reward logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the work-root both participates in the familiar righteous-deeds formula and returns at the end as the domain of excellence.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie this verb to the local second occurrence of the same root and to the surah's reward promise in 18:2.

topics.headline: doing-good bridge to later reward scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this work vocabulary belongs to a wider surah pattern that later reappears with righteous action and good reward (18:88, 18:107).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete later references and do not overrule the local parse.

words.gloss_range: the restorative or sound things, substantivized as the direct object of working
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, repair, fitness, and restoration against corruption; local form presents an open class of restorative deeds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: work verb governing this object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣaliḥat}}) is the object of {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilu}}), even though its sound feminine plural ending does not show a normal visible accusative fatḥa. It is an active participle used as a noun: the ayah speaks of working the sound or restorative things without naming a separate noun such as deeds. That form keeps the category open while the root field keeps the quality concrete: these are actions that restore soundness, make things fit, and resist corruption. Only after this object closes the human relative clause does the ayah shift into first-person divine guarantee, and the same righteous-deeds profile reappears later with its garden outcome (18:107).

topics.headline: substantivized restorative object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word functions as the worked object while leaving the class of restorative things open.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the active participle as the explicit direct object of the work verb.

topics.headline: soundness and repair specify the deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object evaluates work by restorative soundness rather than by quantity or visibility.
topics.reason: The repair and fit-for-use pressures survive as root-family specificity, while the local surface remains a substantivized active participle for righteous or restorative things.

topics.headline: formula closes before divine speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the faith-and-restorative-deeds profile is complete before the divine first-person guarantee begins.
topics.reason: The word ends the relative clause, and the collocation rows tie this phrase to reward formulas including 18:2.

topics.headline: later righteous-deeds outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same righteous-deeds profile reappears later with its garden outcome (18:107).
topics.reason: The cited later verse repeats the same faith-and-righteous-deeds formula, so the echo can be kept as a concrete surah-level connection.

words.root_display: no lexical root (emphatic particle plus first-person plural pronoun)
words.gloss_range: inner emphatic divine first-person clause that supplies the predicate-content of the opening frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: outer emphatic particle whose predicate is completed here

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) is where the sentence changes register. The opening third-person description of those who believed and worked restorative deeds gives way to direct divine first-person speech. Grammatically, this inner emphatic clause supplies the predicate-content that the first {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) left pending, and its pronoun installs the speaker before the negation begins. The same emphatic divine voice that marked prepared fire in 18:29 now carries the opposite outcome: reward will not be wasted.

topics.headline: inner emphatic clause completes the outer frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammatical answer to the believers' description is not a noun phrase but a divine policy statement.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the inner {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) clause the predicate-content of the opening emphatic frame.

topics.headline: third-person description becomes divine commitment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sudden move from describing humans to hearing the divine speaker personally guarantee preservation.
topics.reason: The suffix in {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:inna}}) and the first-person verb at word 9 together establish the divine speaker as grammatical subject of the guarantee.

topics.headline: same voice, opposite outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:29 and 18:30 use emphatic divine speech for opposite boundary outcomes: prepared fire and preserved reward.
topics.reason: The boundary row is a concrete contrast with 18:29 and is supported by the repeated emphatic first-person register.

words.gloss_range: simple negation of the following imperfect verb, forming a standing non-wasting policy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperfect verb negated by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:la}}) is negative, not prohibitive. It does not command someone not to waste; it reports what the divine speaker does not do. Its immediate scope is {{ar:نُضِيعُ}} ({{tr:nudiʿu}}), so the predicate denies wasting before the object is named. With the imperfect verb, the denial reads as a standing policy: the first reassurance is not yet the positive reward scene of 18:31, but the removal of loss as a threat.

topics.headline: negative particle over the wasting verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle negates divine wasting, not the reward, the deed, or a command directed at humans.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as negation and attachment support says its scope is the verb phrase {{ar:نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ}} ({{tr:nudiʿu ajra}}).

topics.headline: non-loss before reward detail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first form of reassurance is an ongoing non-loss policy before the next ayah elaborates reward.
topics.reason: The negation governs an imperfect verb inside the inner predicate, and the CRITICAL rows rightly distinguish this guarantee from the later reward description in 18:31.

topics.headline: inner predicate built around negated waste
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine predicate is organized around denied waste before it becomes an account of compensation.
topics.reason: The predication evidence makes the negated verb phrase the predicate of the inner emphatic clause.

words.gloss_range: we cause to be lost, let go to waste, neglect, or allow to perish; negated here with reward as object
words.root_gloss_range: loss, waste, ruin, neglect, abandonment, and vulnerability; local Form IV under negation selects active non-wasting preservation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: inner divine first-person emphatic subject
direct object protected from loss

words.prose: {{ar:نُضِيعُ}} ({{tr:nudiʿu}}) is the verb of the guarantee. Its first-person plural prefix agrees with the divine speaker in {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:inna}}), and its direct object is {{ar:أَجْرَ}} ({{tr:ajra}}): the protected item is the recompense generated by excellent action. The Form IV shape makes the denied act causative or permissive, so the line means more than simple non-destruction; God does not cause the reward to be lost or let it go to waste. The wider root pressure of abandonment sharpens that assurance, while the local sense remains non-wasting, not literal orphanhood. A Form II variant intensifies the same denial of repeated or systematic wasting, while the local canonical surface remains Form IV. After 18:29's fire and ruined resting-place, the same boundary turns into a marked formula of preservation, also echoed in the non-wasting reward formula (3:171, 7:170, 9:120, 11:115, 12:56, 12:90).

topics.headline: active divine preservation of reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine agency actively guards the reward from being caused or allowed to be lost.
topics.reason: The local verb is first-person plural, Form IV, transitive, and negated, with {{ar:أَجْرَ}} ({{tr:ajra}}) as explicit object.

topics.headline: ongoing non-loss before the object appears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the continuing denial of waste before the sentence names reward as the protected object.
topics.reason: The imperfect under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:la}}) and the sequence of negated verb before object support this local payoff.

topics.headline: loss includes abandonment and neglect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied loss is not only destruction but also abandonment, squandering, or leaving the recompense unguarded.
topics.reason: The dependent or orphaned sense is root-family enrichment; it sharpens abandonment imagery but does not become the direct local meaning of {{ar:نُضِيعُ}} ({{tr:nudiʿu}}).

topics.headline: variant intensifies the non-wasting claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a recognized variant reading can intensify the same denial of wasting without changing the local canonical Form IV parse.
topics.reason: The Form II variant is useful as apparatus, but the canonical local surface remains Form IV.

topics.headline: preservation formula reverses punishment imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:30 converts the prior scene of ruin into a marked Quranic formula of reward not being wasted.
topics.reason: The non-wasting reward formula has concrete cross-references, and the boundary contrast with 18:29 is directly local.

words.gloss_range: recompense, wage, or reward, singular and construct before whoever
words.root_gloss_range: wage, recompense, hire, and restorative return; local form makes recompense the protected object of non-wasting

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct possessor that defines whose reward is protected

words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرَ}} ({{tr:ajra}}) is the object protected from loss. As a singular verbal noun, it gathers recompense as one due return rather than a set of scattered prizes, and as a construct before {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) it binds that reward to whoever is defined by excellent deed. The wage or recompense sense matters: the preserved thing corresponds to enacted excellence, not to a detached gift. A restorative root edge also fits the ayah's logic, since restorative deeds receive a return that repairs value, but that remains an enrichment rather than the direct local sense. Within the surah, the promised good reward of 18:2 becomes here the reward guaranteed not to be wasted.

topics.headline: recompense as the protected object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the thing shielded from loss is recompense itself, with verbal force tied to prior action.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:أَجْرَ}} ({{tr:ajra}}) as the accusative verbal noun object of {{ar:نُضِيعُ}} ({{tr:nudiʿu}}).

topics.headline: reward bound to whoever excelled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final chain narrowing from protected reward to the exact agent and the quality-domain of the deed.
topics.reason: The construct relation binds {{ar:أَجْرَ}} ({{tr:ajra}}) to {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}), whose clause then supplies the excellent-deed criterion.

topics.headline: earned return with restorative pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reward as earned recompense that can also carry a restorative edge beside the ayah's repair vocabulary.
topics.reason: The wage sense is local; the bone-healing pressure is useful only as root-family enrichment that aligns with the repair field.

topics.headline: 18:2 promise becomes preserved reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:30 restates the good reward promised in 18:2 as a guarantee that the reward will not be wasted.
topics.reason: The rows provide a concrete same-surah connection between the reward promise in 18:2 and the preservation guarantee in 18:30.

topics.headline: one gathered recompense after punishment scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah shifts from bodily punishment imagery to one gathered economy of preserved recompense.
topics.reason: The singular form and the boundary contrast are both locally visible and do not disturb the direct object parse.

words.root_display: no lexical root (relative or conditional pronoun)
words.gloss_range: whoever, functioning as construct possessor and opening the final relative clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct phrase binding reward to whoever
defined plural group contrasted with the open whoever-slot

words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) sits inside the construct phrase {{ar:أَجْرَ مَنْ}} ({{tr:ajra man}}), so the reward is the reward of whoever is then defined by excellence in deed. Its relative or conditional openness matters: after the ayah began with the defined plural {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhina}}), this word expands the guarantee into an open principle for anyone who meets the action-quality criterion. It also nests the final clause inside the protected reward, replacing the closed wrongdoer reference of 18:29 with an open whoever-slot.

topics.headline: whoever owns the protected reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is bound to a person-slot immediately defined by excellence in deed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) both the construct complement of reward and the subject of {{ar:أَحْسَنَ}} ({{tr:aḥsana}}).

topics.headline: from defined group to whoever criterion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guarantee widens from the named believing group into an open criterion of excellent action.
topics.reason: QAC allows the relative function, and the CRITICAL rows preserve the legitimate openness carried by {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}).

topics.headline: open clause after closed wrongdoer chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boundary replaces the trapped reference of 18:29 with a morally open whoever-clause.
topics.reason: The boundary topic is concrete because 18:30's final relative clause begins with an open pronoun after 18:29's wrongdoer-focused closure.

words.gloss_range: did excellently or made good, with elative better/best resonance in the afʿal shape
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, excellence, and doing beyond adequacy; local grammar favors a perfect-verb reading with comparative resonance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: generic whoever-slot supplying the subject
accusative specification naming the deed domain

words.prose: {{ar:أَحْسَنَ}} ({{tr:aḥsana}}) is best read locally as a perfect verb supplied with its subject by {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}): whoever did excellently. The following {{ar:عَمَلًا}} ({{tr:ʿamalan}}) specifies the domain, so the guarantee rewards excellence enacted in deed, and the masculine singular verb serves the generic {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) without narrowing the whoever-slot to one named person. The afʿal shape also keeps an elative edge, letting better or best quality press on the phrase without replacing the verbal parse. This is more than adequacy: the field of beauty, goodness, and iḥsan makes deed quality the measure. The exact testing phrase from 18:7 returns here, alongside the wider best-in-deed testing field (11:7, 67:2), so the ayah answers the question of who is best in deed with the assurance that such reward is not wasted. At the boundary, this quality evaluation reverses 18:29's bad outcome with good action and anticipates the deed-beauty reward logic of 18:88.

topics.headline: verbal excellence with best-deed resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names enacted excellence while still carrying the better-or-best resonance of its form.
topics.reason: The local syntax supports a perfect-verb reading with {{ar:عَمَلًا}} ({{tr:ʿamalan}}) as specification; the afʿal ambiguity survives as resonance, not a replacement parse.

topics.headline: excellence qualifies the work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preserved reward is tied to beautiful excellence in action, not merely bare compliance.
topics.reason: The root field and the placement before {{ar:عَمَلًا}} ({{tr:ʿamalan}}) make quality of action central to the local phrase.

topics.headline: singular verb for universal whoever
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how a grammatically singular verb can serve the open whoever-slot without narrowing the guarantee to one named person.
topics.reason: The subject relation is supplied by {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}), and the masculine singular form matches the generic pronoun.

topics.headline: test of best deed answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the test phrase about who is best in deed (18:7, 11:7, 67:2) returns here as the rewarded outcome.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references for the exact or near-exact testing formula and its local return in 18:30.

topics.headline: final movement turns to evaluated work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's final movement shifts from protected reward to the quality of the deed, reversing 18:29's bad outcome with good action.
topics.reason: The word stands before the final deed term, and the boundary/intertext rows connect the quality evaluation to 18:29 and 18:88.

words.gloss_range: deed or work, accusative specification for the respect in which excellence applies
words.root_gloss_range: work, deed, intentional action, and productive practice; local ending leaves the domain open while making work the measure of excellence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: excellence verb governing the final specification

words.prose: {{ar:عَمَلًا}} ({{tr:ʿamalan}}) closes the ayah by naming deed as the domain in which excellence is measured. Locally it functions best as accusative specification after {{ar:أَحْسَنَ}} ({{tr:aḥsana}}), though an object nuance can still stress that good work is produced. Its tanwīn and indefinite form leave the class of work open rather than listing a single deed-type. As a verbal noun, it turns action into a criterion for evaluation, and as the final word it closes both emphatic scopes. It also answers the earlier work-root at word 5 and the testing phrase of 18:7, with the wider best-in-deed field still in view (11:7, 67:2), so the ayah moves from doing restorative deeds to the open measure of excellent deed. After the sensory punishment of 18:29, the final word redirects attention to accountable work.

topics.headline: deed specifies the domain of excellence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word specifies the respect in which excellence applies while keeping a secondary production-of-good-work nuance possible.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly marks {{ar:عَمَلًا}} ({{tr:ʿamalan}}) as specification; the object reading is retained only as a secondary nuance.

topics.headline: open deed-domain becomes the criterion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends with an open category of work, not a closed list of rewarded deeds.
topics.reason: The verbal noun and tanwīn support an indefinite, open domain of accountable work.

topics.headline: from worked deeds to deed measured
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's inner arc: the group works restorative deeds, then the final clause measures excellence in deed.
topics.reason: The same work root appears at word 5 as a verb and word 13 as a verbal noun, creating a local frame.

topics.headline: test phrase closes the double emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exact best-in-deed testing field (18:7, 11:7, 67:2) becomes the grammatical endpoint of the whole double-emphasis guarantee.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete testing references and the word is the final endpoint of both emphatic scopes.

topics.headline: abstract work after sensory punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boundary redirects attention from the sensory punishment of 18:29 to accountable work as the final measure.
topics.reason: The boundary contrast is local and concrete: 18:29 ends in punishment imagery, while 18:30 ends on deed.

baseline_models.mechanism: Trusting assent orients purposive action; soundness opposes corruption; ihsan perfects and benefits; the negated loss protects the return due to that labor. The repeated عمل binds the workers' act to the quality of the work assessed.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the trusted orientation from which the work proceeds.
Purposive action links the believers' doing to the work whose quality is assessed.
Soundness against corruption gives the acts their restorative moral direction.
Going away, perishing, or missing is explicitly negated as the failure mode of the return.
Recompense or hire makes the protected object a return attached to labor.
Beneficent, perfected action makes excellence functional rather than merely attractive.

changed_reading.before: The ayah generally promises that good people will be rewarded.
changed_reading.after: The ayah describes an inspectable labor-return chain: trusted orientation becomes purposive, sound, perfected work, and its due return is barred from disappearance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لا نضيع أجر من أحسن عملا
baseline_models.mechanism: The loss root also names an estate or livelihood that deteriorates when untended, while عمل spans intentional work and manual production. The promise can therefore be heard materially: excellent work is a productive holding whose proceeds remain under competent care rather than becoming an abandoned asset.

activation_trace.role: An estate or property vulnerable when untended supplies the conserved-work-product image under the negated verb.
Craft, livelihood, and earning turn non-loss into preservation of productive value.
Hands-on workers make the protected value the output of real production, not an abstract label.
Wage or recompense identifies the proceeds that belong with the work.
Skillful perfection and beneficence specify how the work-product becomes excellent.

changed_reading.before: Non-loss means that a future reward is remembered.
changed_reading.after: Non-loss also resembles stewardship of a productive work-product: its earned value is neither left untended nor detached from its worker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding fixed writing and denial of substitution sharpen the focus promise from memory into claim security: a labor-return established under an unexchangeable word cannot be displaced by another entry or claimant.

activation_trace.role: Negated disappearance names the failure that secured registration prevents.
The wage supplies the claim whose attachment to the work must remain intact.
A written establishment carrying judgment or decree supplies the durable registration image.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the substitution that the context explicitly denies.

structural_cues: 18:27 denies any substituter for the Lord's words; 18:30 repeats a first-person plural divine guarantee of non-loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding establishment and denied substitution; I infer that work and wage are analogically secured as an irreducible claim. A live alternative is that 18:27 secures revelation alone and does not specify a recompense ledger.

changed_reading.before: God will not happen to overlook the reward.
changed_reading.after: The reward is treated as a secured claim whose registration and attachment cannot be substituted away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus category of sound work is concretized as maintenance of attention and company: hold oneself with the callers, keep the gaze from crossing beyond them toward display, and refuse the neglect that dissipates an affair. Divine non-loss answers a human obligation not to let people fall out of care.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action lets the preceding imperatives specify what sound work can look like.
Removing social estrangement makes staying with the worshipping group a work of repaired relation.
Negated disappearance becomes the divine counterpart to refusing human abandonment.
Holding the self against distress supplies the sustained effort needed to remain with others.
The eye as care and guardianship turns looking into an allocation of protective attention.
Displayed adornment supplies the rival metric that draws attention away from the cared-for group.
Neglect, wasting, and leaving provide the human failure directly reversed by لا نضيع.

structural_cues: 18:28 chains restraint, companionship, gaze, desire, obedience, heedlessness, and excess immediately before the focus's عمل/ضيع contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restrained companionship, guarded sight, alluring display, and neglect; I infer a maintenance relation in which attention keeps persons from social disappearance. A narrower live alternative confines these imperatives to devotional discipline rather than a general ethic of care.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds remain an unspecified class of meritorious acts.
changed_reading.after: Sound work includes the disciplined social act of not letting less prestigious companions disappear from one's field of care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is bracketed by two resting outcomes. Hostile enclosure and bad support precede it; sheltered gardens, returning recompense, and good support follow it. أجر is thus activated not merely as credit but as a deed's lived return: the surrounding condition in which its worker finally rests.

activation_trace.role: Recompense attached to work is the pivot between the two realized outcomes.
Beneficent excellence anticipates the following evaluation of the good resting place.
An enclosure of overpowering ruin gives the negative return a surrounding, inescapable form.
Resting support is evaluated as bad, establishing the negative side of the bracket.
A garden sheltered by vegetation gives the positive return a habitable form.
Recompense returning to its worker supplies the causal return from deed to condition.
Good resting support reverses the prior bad support and completes the spatial contrast.

structural_cues: 18:30 stands between 18:29's bad مرتفق and 18:31's good مرتفق; 18:31 also places ثواب and حسنت beside the focus's أجر and أحسن.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical-spatial bracket and a recompense that returns; I infer that the return is embodied as the worker's eventual habitat. The live alternative is that reward merely grants access to the habitat rather than becoming it.

changed_reading.before: Reward is a transferable credit delivered after the deed.
changed_reading.after: Reward is also the deed returning as a surrounding condition, either hostile enclosure or sheltered rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cultivated pair supplies a production model: growth is arranged, each garden yields its produce, and none of that yield is withheld. Against this, لا نضيع أجر reads as exact moral harvest accounting in which no matured return due from sound work is shorted.

activation_trace.role: The estate vulnerable to neglect lets the following gardens materialize the focus root as productive property.
The labor-return supplies the moral equivalent of yield owed from cultivation.
Planting and nurturing growth establish the productive process analogous to purposive work.
Emergence of growth and produce supplies the transition from cultivated process to realized output.
The yield of trees and crops names the output against which completeness can be measured.
Withholding someone from a right supplies the denied shortfall: the gardens withhold none of their due yield.

structural_cues: 18:32 arranges vines, palms, and cultivation; 18:33 says both gardens gave their yield and withheld nothing, immediately after the focus promise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, completed yield, and non-withholding; I infer an analogy between agricultural output and the return generated by moral work. A live alternative treats the gardens only as a worldly test and not as an explanatory image for أجر.

changed_reading.before: Every good deed receives some unspecified reward.
changed_reading.after: Sound work matures into a fully accounted yield: none of the return properly due from it is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owner converts numerical abundance into a forecast of permanent and superior return, but his productive holding perishes and the capital sent into it ends over collapsed trellises. This strengthens the estate branch of ضيع while separating divine non-loss from visible asset growth: the guaranteed wage is precisely what is not exposed to the estate's failed forecast and structure.

activation_trace.role: An estate that can be lost when its care fails is the focus anchor for the parable's asset collapse.
The protected labor-return is distinguished from the owner's current capital and projected gain.
Qualitative excellence blocks sheer quantity from serving as the measure of preserved return.
Competitive dominance by number supplies the owner's mistaken metric of superiority.
Accumulated wealth supplies the visible asset base from which he extrapolates.
An outcome that cannot be trusted exposes his permanence claim as a hazardous forecast.
A thing going until it perishes names the asset failure he wrongly excludes.
Capital going out in expenditure identifies what he sees stranded in the ruined holding.
Falling and structural collapse materialize the loss of the productive system.
Grape trellising identifies the productive support whose collapse leaves the investment without yield.

structural_cues: 18:34 boasts of more wealth and manpower; 18:35-36 projects permanence and a better return; 18:40-42 reverses the forecast through bare ground, inaccessible water, engulfed produce, and collapsed supports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prosperity forecast followed by asset, water, capital, and structural failure; I infer that divine non-loss insulates moral return from those worldly failure modes. The live alternative is a simpler contrast between this life and the next without activating ضيعة as an estate.

changed_reading.before: Preserved reward might be inferred from uninterrupted growth in present wealth and support.
changed_reading.after: Present abundance is an unreliable forecast; the focus guarantees a return whose preservation is categorically unlike a fragile estate's capital and yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, proportioning, rejection of divine partnership, and gathered strength revise the apparent worker-wage contract. The worker genuinely acts and can perfect the act, but does so with formed and enabled capacities; ihsan is responsive craftsmanship, not autonomous authorship of value.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action preserves real human agency within the revised account.
Perfecting and benefiting name the quality achieved through the received capacity.
Creative origination supplies the prior source of the worker and the worker's capacities.
Integrity and completion in the self supply the formed capacity brought to action.
The divine-partnership branch blocks turning competent action into co-sovereign authorship.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies the enabling power that the speaker denies exists independently of God.

structural_cues: 18:37 moves from created materials to a proportioned person; 18:38-39 answer boast with non-partnership and no independent power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created formation, anti-partnership, and non-independent strength; I infer that excellent work is a faithful deployment of enabled agency. A live alternative limits these cues to correcting the garden owner's theology without modifying the focus's account of action.

changed_reading.before: The excellent worker independently authors value and then receives payment for it.
changed_reading.after: The worker's excellence is real but derivative: a perfected use of created and enabled capacity whose return God preserves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failure of factional and self-help is followed by true divine governance, fixed entitlement, returning recompense, and final consequence. These cues expose the mechanism of لا نضيع: the wage and its outcome remain with the only custodian able to administer and return them without rival rescue systems.

activation_trace.role: Non-disappearance is the preservation effected by the final custodian.
The work-linked recompense is what custody carries through to outcome.
Absent external aid and failed self-vindication remove rival mechanisms of preservation.
Taking charge and administering the affair supplies the positive mechanism of divine custody.
Fixed obligation and entitlement make the preserved return due rather than arbitrary.
Recompense returning to its worker describes custody completing its delivery.
The final consequence extends preservation from immediate wage to the work's last outcome.

structural_cues: 18:43 twice negates effective human support; 18:44 assigns true ولاية to God and pairs better ثواب with better عقب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed human aid, divine administration, due right, returned recompense, and final outcome; I infer a custody chain that explains non-loss. A live alternative reads ولاية only as sovereignty disclosed after collapse, not administration of each wage.

changed_reading.before: Non-loss rests on an unspecified exercise of divine power.
changed_reading.after: Non-loss is traced as custody: divine administration preserves a due return and carries it through to its final consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates أجر's form-distant image of setting a fracture, not its ordinary recompense branch. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and coheres with صالح as anti-corruption, ihsan as perfecting, and the later collapse image. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a replacement translation of أجر.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أجر with صالحات and أحسن, under the later image of collapse

activation_trace.role: Setting a fracture, even where crookedness remains, recasts the return as reparative work on damage.
Soundness against corruption gives the repair image a moral anchor.
Perfecting and benefiting make restoration one possible mode of the promised good.
Structural falling and collapse supply the damage against which reparative recompense becomes imaginable.

changed_reading.before: Reward is only an external payment added after good work.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, reward may also be reparative: the setting-right of damage so that sound action is not lost even where traces of fracture remain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it presses the noun-estate and administrative branches of ضيع/عمل beneath a verbal denial of wasting. It remains visibly anchored because the negation suppresses the inventory's exact failure of too many holdings to manage, while 18:44 closes with divine administration. Downstream prose should qualify it as a governance analogy about scale, not as the lexical sense of نضيع in isolation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إنا لا نضيع joined to repeated عمل

activation_trace.role: Too many estates or causes producing paralysis supplies the precise administrative failure negated of the divine plural speaker.
Taking charge of an office or work supplies the administration frame for handling every claim.
Each wage remains attached to its labor rather than being lost in portfolio complexity.
Final divine administration sustains the image of custody capable of handling multiplicity without triage.

changed_reading.before: God remembers each reward despite there being many deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the plural guarantee denies administrative overload: no work-claim is triaged away because the custodian never loses track of which holding requires action.

strongest_changes: 18:28 turns sound work into maintenance of social attention, with human neglect directly reversed by divine non-loss.
18:29-31 make recompense a returning habitat, not only a credit, through the paired bad and good resting places.
18:32-42 activate ضيعة as productive estate: complete yield clarifies exact return, while collapse separates preserved wage from fragile capital.
18:43-44 supply a custody mechanism in which divine administration carries due recompense through to final outcome.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact labor vocabulary became a hinge between two systems of value: ornamental abundance and exposed estates can mismeasure or lose their returns, whereas trusted, sound, perfected work is held as a due claim, realized yield, lived habitat, and final consequence.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the garden sequence directly models moral yield or only contrasts worldly and final goods.
Whether the habitat reading makes recompense constitutive of final condition or merely the means of entering it.
The estate, fracture-repair, and administrative-overload branches are productive but form-distant and should remain explicitly analogical.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Trust becomes preserved intentional work.** `ء م ن` B001 (“settled security and trust”) leads to `ع م ل` B001 (“intentional doing”), and the resulting wage is not lost. The wall preserves treasure until maturity (18:82), while unbelieving works become weightless (18:104–105). I infer that divine preservation carries sound intention across delayed visibility. The ayah reads as conservation of morally formed action, not only later payment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:82’s protected treasure and 18:105’s weightless works revealed two opposed forms of temporal conservation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Work retained like a maintained holding.** `ض ي ع/B001` supplies losing, wasting, or causing loss; dormant `ض ي ع/B002` is an estate or landed holding, and `B003` a craft or livelihood. The next three ayat render reward as an inhabited garden (18:31–33), with cultivated boundaries, crop, and flowing water, after 18:28 warned against merely visible worldly adornment. I infer that good work is not discarded output: it is preserved as a maintained productive holding. `لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ` therefore reads as conservation and conversion of labor, not only non-cancellation of a score.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:31–33 unexpectedly realized the dormant estate and livelihood branches: retained reward becomes an inhabited, cultivated holding.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin elden çıkması, yok olması veya geri alınamayacak biçimde yitmesi çekirdeğini açıkça kurar. Ettirgen kullanımlar bir şeyi korumayıp kayba uğratmayı; aileyi, malı, emeği, karşılığı ve inancı boşa çıkarmama örnekleri ise bu çekirdeğin farklı alanlardaki gerçekleşmelerini gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal taşınmaz mal, geçim işi, işlerin çoğalıp yayılması veya açlık anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın çekirdeği hem de yalnız belirli söz kalıplarında gerçekleşen bağımlı kullanımları kapsar; kalıba bağlı örnekler yalın anlamın tamamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin elden çıkması, yok olması ya da geri alınamaz biçimde yitmesi; ettirgen kullanımda ise onu korumayıp kayba uğratma. Bakmakla yükümlü olunan kişileri veya malı sahipsiz bırakma, emek ve karşılığın boşa gitmesi ile zamanında değerlendirilmeyen fırsat bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şey elden çıkar, yok olur veya artık erişilemez hale gelir.
Bir kimse bir şeyi korumayıp onun kaybolmasına, yok olmasına veya boşa gitmesine yol açar.
Aile bireylerini ya da malı bakımsız ve sahipsiz bırakmak, kayba yol açmanın insana ve mala dönük uygulamasıdır.
Emek, karşılık veya inanç gibi soyut değerlerin boşa çıkması da kayıp çekirdeği üzerinden anlatılır.
Bir fırsatı zamanında kullanmayıp sonradan istemek, geri gelmeyen kaybı anlatan sözle örneklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, temel anlamı bir şeyin yitmesi veya yok olması olarak birlikte verir; ettirgen biçimleri korumama ve kayba yol açma, bağımlı kullanımları ise aileyi ya da malı sahipsiz bırakma ve bir değeri boşa çıkarma yönünde genişletir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı açıkça taşınmaz mal ve özellikle arazi, ev, bağ ile bahçe varlığı olarak tanımlar. Bu varlığın bakım ve bayındırlık bırakıldığında elden çıkabilmesi adlandırmanın gerekçesidir; kayıp olayının kendisi dalın tanımı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye ait arazi, ev, bağ, bahçe ve benzeri taşınmaz malların bütünü. Bu malların bakım ve bayındırlık bırakıldığında elden çıkabilmesi, adlandırmanın anlam bağını açıklar.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ait taşınmaz mal veya bu malların oluşturduğu varlık bütünü adlandırılır.
Arazi, ev, bağ ve meyve bahçesi bu taşınmaz mal bütününün başlıca örnekleridir.
Bakım ve bayındırlık bırakıldığında malın elden çıkması, adın kayıp anlamıyla olan bağını gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı taşınmaz mal, arazi ve evler için ortaklaşa tanımlar; bağ ve bahçe gibi üretken arazi varlıklarını da kapsar ve düzenli bakım bırakıldığında bunların elden çıkabileceğini belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Geçim amacı taşıyan düzenli iş, el sanatı ve kazanç yolu ile sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İyi veya kötü her türlü eylem, bir işte çaba gösterme ve genel davranış alanı da kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kimsenin emek vererek bir iş yapması ve bununla kazanç sağlaması iki dalda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal meslek edinilmiş geçim işidir; komşu dal ise geçim amacı olsun olmasın her türlü çalışma ve davranışı daha geniş biçimde anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İşin kişinin geçim yolu olması belirleyicidir; özel bir ustalık derecesi zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: El işinde beceri, ustalık ve işi iyi yapma niteliği anlamın merkezindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: El sanatı ve üretici çalışma, iki dalın ortak uygulama alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapılan işi ve kazanç yolunu adlandırır; komşu dal işi yapan kişinin beceri ve ustalık niteliğini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bağımsız geçim işi, üretim ve alım satım faaliyeti açıkça kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başkasına hizmet etme, ev işi yapma ve çalışmada becerikli olma ayrıca kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin düzenli biçimde emek verdiği iş ve bu işteki uygulama iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal geçim ve kazanç sağlayan işi adlandırır; komşu dal hizmet ilişkisini ve işi beceriyle yapmayı da anlamın merkezine alır.

source_note.TA: Kişinin geçim işi, el sanatı ve kazanç yolu; alım satım ile sürü yönetimini de kapsayan tek kaynaklı bir anlamdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli söz kalıplarında bir kişinin mallarının, işlerinin veya ilgilenmesi gereken nedenlerin çoğalıp yayılmasını ve kişinin hangisinden başlayacağını bilememesini anlatır. Bu, bir şeyi korumayıp kaybetme anlamı değil, çokluk ve dağılma yüzünden baş edememe durumudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen kişi ve iş çokluğu kalıplarına bağlıdır; genel kayıp, taşınmaz mal veya yalın çoğalma anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız verilen kişi merkezli söz birimleri ve söz kalıbında gerçekleşir; bunlardan genel bir yalın kaybetme ya da yayılma anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yalnız verilen söz kalıplarında, bir kimsenin mallarının, işlerinin veya ilgilenmesi gereken uğraşların çoğalıp yayılması. Bu çokluk, kişinin hangisinden başlayacağını bilememesine ve işleriyle baş edememesine yol açar.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin malları, işleri veya ilgilenmesi gereken uğraşları çoğalıp geniş bir alana yayılır.
Çoğalan ve dağılan uğraşlar, kişinin nereden başlayacağını bilememesine ve baş etmekte zorlanmasına yol açar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişi merkezli belirli kullanımlarda mal ve işlerin çoğalıp yayılması anlamında birleşir; ayrıca uğraşların dağılmasının kişiyi nereden başlayacağını bilemez durumda bırakabileceğini açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin mal, iş ve uğraşlarının çoğalıp dağılması yüzünden hangisinden başlayacağını bilemediği durumda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşlerin çoğalması, yayılması ve kişinin bunlarla baş etmekte zorlanması bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğalıp dağılan uğraşların kişiyi nereden başlayacağını bilemez durumda bıraktığı bağlamda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Uğraş çokluğunu, dağılmayı ve kişinin bunlarla baş edememesi sonucunu birlikte taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yalnız belirli bir anlatımda bağırsağın aç olarak nitelenmesini ve bunun kişinin açlığını bildirmesini açıkça kurar. İkinci örnek de aç diş ile aç bağırsak görüntüsünü bir araya getirerek aynı beden temelli açlık anlatımını destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel kaybolma veya yok olma anlamı değildir; açlığı beden bölümü üzerinden anlatan belirli kullanımla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız verilen aç bağırsak söz kalıbına bağlıdır; buradan yalın biçim için genel bir açlık ya da kayıp anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yalnız verilen söz kalıbında, yemeğin aç bir bağırsağa düşmesi, yani kişinin aç olması. Aç diş ile aç bağırsak görüntüsünün birlikte kullanılması bu beden temelli anlatımı güçlendirir.

facets.statement: Bağırsağın aç diye nitelenmesi, kişinin aç olduğunu beden bölümü üzerinden anlatır.
Aç dişin aç bağırsağa düşmesi görüntüsü, yeme ve açlık durumunu birlikte canlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal tek kaynakta, kişinin açlığını bağırsağı aç diye niteleyerek anlatan bir kullanım olarak tanıklanır; aç dişin aç bağırsağa düşmesi görüntüsü de aynı anlamı örnekler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yapılan işten doğan yararlı karşılığı ana anlam olarak verir ve bunun dünyalık ödeme, manevi ödül, kiralama bedeli, evlilikte kadına verilen bedel ve ücret karşılığı çalıştırma gibi gerçekleşmelerini açıkça kapsar. Hazırlık çerçevesi bu katmanları aynı yararlı karşılık çekirdeğine bağlı tuttuğu için branch kimliği kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca yararlı bir dönüşü kapsar; zararlı karşılık ve ceza bu branchin sınırları dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak yararlı karşılık çekirdeğini verir; kiralama, işçi tutma, evlilik bedeli ve çocuk ölümüyle ilgili kullanımları yalnızca kendi biçim veya kuruluşlarına bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yapılması veya bir anlaşmanın kurulması nedeniyle kişiye dönen yararlı karşılıktır; bu karşılık dünyalık bir ödeme ya da manevi ve öte dünyaya ilişkin bir ödül olabilir. Kiralama bedeli, ücretle çalıştırma ve evlilikte kadına verilen bedel bu çekirdeğin belirli ilişkilere bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Yapılan bir iş nedeniyle işi yapan kişiye yarar olarak dönen karşılıktır.
Karşılık, dünyalık bir ödeme, kiralama bedeli veya hizmet sözleşmesinde verilen bedel olabilir.
Karşılık, iyi bir iş için bu dünyada veya öte dünyada beklenen manevi ödül olabilir.
Evlilik ilişkisinde kadına verilmesi gereken bedel de yararlı karşılık olarak adlandırılır.
Bir kişiyi bedel karşılığında çalıştırmak üzere tutma ve o kişiyi çalışan kılma ilişkisini de kapsar.
